quest.title: The Illumiscreen: III
quest.description: Brother Qian from the Liyue Adventurers' Guild is still inviting people to try playing with the Illumiscreen...

talks.objective: Talk to Brother Qian at night (21:00 – 05:00)

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: Try the Illumiscreen...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you have another image for me?

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: You bet! And since you solved both the previous ones so easily, I've swapped the lanterns for the most difficult ones available.

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: The same principle applies — you combine three images to make one whole. The difficulty is in the fact that they're <color=#00E1FFFF>linked together</color> this time.

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: Hehe, you'll see what I mean when you give it a try. This time, you're looking for a <color=#00E1FFFF>divine crane</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: Once you've got the images to align, you can go find the treasure.

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: How is the treasure hunt going?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've found every last chest.

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: Wow, you managed to decipher all three images... That's impressive...

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: Ahem. The Guild has prepared an extra-special gift for you on account of you being such an accomplished adventurer.

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: See those chests? Go ahead and open them. The contents are all for you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But if I take all the prizes...

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: Yep, there'll be squat left for anyone else. That's adventuring for you! Finders keepers.

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: Alright then, happy Lantern Rite. Have a good one.

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: Wow. You, um, did it.

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: All in a day's work for you, huh? I gotta say, you're one heck of an adventurer.

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: Go take a look at the screens. You'll find all the treasure clues in there.

talks.objective: Find the treasure area indicated by the Illumiscreen
Find the treasure area indicated by the Illumiscreen
Find the treasure area indicated by the Illumiscreen

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: The treasure has all been prepared specially by the Guild. Happy hunting.

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: If you'd like to have a try, please come back at nighttime.

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: This time, try and make a <color=#00E1FFFF>crane</color>.

talks.objective: Open the chest just opposite of Brother Qian
